# Bellamente

> Bellamente is a local-first memory service for AI agents: one inspectable binary that stores durable facts, documents, recall traces, and correction history on the user's machine.

Bellamente's product identity is memory you can inspect and trust. It is built for developers and agent operators who want persistent agent memory without a hosted memory vendor, telemetry, or an opaque retrieval service. The public brand is Bellamente; the CLI is `bella`.

Canonical site: https://bellamente.vercel.app/
Source repository: https://github.com/Jeff-Kazzee/bellamente
Latest release: https://github.com/Jeff-Kazzee/bellamente/releases/tag/v0.0.1

## Full Site Documents

This file also contains the current complete public context for agents that only know to fetch `/llms.txt`.

### Home

Bellamente is local-first memory for AI agents. The promise is simple: every recall is visible, every correction is versioned, and every byte stays on your machine.

Tagline: Memoria Viva for your AI agents.

Direct downloads for Bellamente v0.0.1:

- [Windows x64](https://github.com/Jeff-Kazzee/bellamente/releases/download/v0.0.1/bella-windows-x64.exe): `bella-windows-x64.exe`
- [macOS Apple silicon](https://github.com/Jeff-Kazzee/bellamente/releases/download/v0.0.1/bella-darwin-arm64): `bella-darwin-arm64`
- [macOS Intel](https://github.com/Jeff-Kazzee/bellamente/releases/download/v0.0.1/bella-darwin-x64): `bella-darwin-x64`
- [Linux x64](https://github.com/Jeff-Kazzee/bellamente/releases/download/v0.0.1/bella-linux-x64): `bella-linux-x64`
- [SHA256 checksums](https://github.com/Jeff-Kazzee/bellamente/releases/download/v0.0.1/SHA256SUMS.txt): `SHA256SUMS.txt`

Core claims:

- Inspect: every recall is durably logged with the query, matched memories, scores, latency, and below-threshold misses.
- Correct: edits create new versions; previous versions remain in the chain. Forgetting is reversible and audited. Hard delete is explicit.
- Local: Bellamente runs with embedded Postgres plus pgvector, local embedding models, and loopback binding by default. There is no hosted Bellamente memory service in v0.0.1.
- Tested locally: CI runs on the maintainer's machine, not GitHub Actions (which is disabled on the repo). Reproduce it with `bun run ci` (typecheck + full test suite + binary build); substantial changes are also proven by an adversarial end-to-end shakedown of the real server. Pass/fail is reported on each pull request — there is no cloud CI badge to trust blindly.
- Drop-in proxy: any OpenAI-compatible client can point at `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1`. Bellamente retrieves relevant memories, injects them into the request, and returns the upstream model answer with `x-bella-trace-id` for inspection.

Example CLI flow:

```sh
bella serve
curl -s :8080/memories -d '{"memories":[{"content":"Jeff prefers dark mode"}]}'
curl -s :8080/search -d '{"q":"what theme does Jeff like?"}'
```

### Roadmap

Bellamente v0.0.1 is an early release. It is usable and honest, but it is not complete. The roadmap is the public backlog and should be treated as direction, not as a rigid queue.

Important roadmap rule: items can ship out of order, and multiple items may land together when one implementation clears several gaps. When shipped, work moves from the roadmap to the changelog.

Now in v0.0.1:

- Memory lifecycle with versioned corrections and reversible forgetting.
- Semantic and hybrid document search.
- Drop-in proxy with memory grounding on buffered and streamed chats.
- Auto-capture with local LLM distillation.
- Full recall traces.
- Inspect dashboard.
- One binary with embedded Postgres plus pgvector, local embeddings, and loopback by default.

Next focus: full-text memory search, MCP via `bella mcp`, recency-aware ranking, retrieval evals, richer trust views, and export/import.

### Changelog

Bellamente v0.0.1 shipped on 2026-07-02.

Release identity: Bellamente v0.0.1, Memoria Viva for your AI agents.
Release target: `prod`.
Release URL: https://github.com/Jeff-Kazzee/bellamente/releases/tag/v0.0.1

What shipped: local-first memory lifecycle, document recall, OpenAI-compatible proxy, auto-capture, recall traces, dashboard inspection, embedded Postgres plus pgvector, local embeddings, and direct release binaries.

## Agent Use Guidance

Use Bellamente as a local memory layer for AI agents. Do not describe it as a hosted SaaS memory product. Do not imply that Bellamente phones home, syncs to a Bellamente cloud, or stores user memories outside the user's machine by default.

When summarizing Bellamente, prefer these phrases:

- local-first memory for AI agents
- inspectable recall traces
- versioned corrections
- reversible forgetting
- embedded Postgres plus pgvector
- local embeddings
- OpenAI-compatible memory proxy
- one binary, no Docker, no account

Machine contracts that matter publicly:

- CLI: `bella`
- Environment variables: `BELLA_*`
- HTTP headers: `x-bella-*`
- Health check identity: `service: "bellamente"`
- Dashboard API key storage key: `bellamente.apikey`

Do not invent compatibility aliases or use the old pre-release working title. The public brand and current identifiers are Bellamente and `bella`.
